questions.question: How does the Lucas test distinguish between propan-1-ol, propan-2-ol and 2-methylpropan-2-ol? State what is observed with each and why.
Write the mechanism of the acid catalysed dehydration of ethanol to ethene with conc. H2SO4 at 443 K. Why does 2-methylpropan-2-ol dehydrate much more easily than ethanol?
Arrange phenol, o-nitrophenol, p-nitrophenol, p-cresol and ethanol in increasing order of acidic strength, and explain the effect of the nitro group on the acidity of phenol.

Match each set of reactants in List I with the product in List II. List I: (A) phenol, Zn dust, heat (B) phenol, CHCl3, NaOH, then HCl (C) phenol, CO2, NaOH, then HCl (D) phenol, conc. HNO3. List II: (I) salicylaldehyde (II) salicylic acid (III) benzene (IV) picric acid.
What are the products when anisole (methoxybenzene) is heated with HI? Explain why phenol and methyl iodide are formed rather than iodobenzene and methanol.
Arrange HCHO, CH3CHO, CH3COCH3 and C6H5COCH3 in decreasing order of reactivity towards nucleophilic addition of HCN, and explain the order using electronic and steric effects.
Name the reaction and give the reagents used to convert (a) benzoyl chloride to benzaldehyde, (b) toluene to benzaldehyde through a chromium complex, and (c) benzene to benzaldehyde with CO and HCl.
How many of the following compounds give a positive Fehling's test? Benzaldehyde, acetaldehyde, acetone, acetophenone, methanal, 4-nitrobenzaldehyde and cyclohexanecarbaldehyde.

How many of the following compounds give a positive iodoform reaction? (a) 1-phenylbutan-2-one (b) 2-methylbutan-2-ol (c) 3-methylbutan-2-ol (d) 1-phenylethanol (e) 3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one (f) 1-phenylpropan-2-ol

Complete reaction of acetaldehyde with excess formaldehyde, on heating with conc. NaOH solution, gives P and Q. Compound P does not give Tollens' test, whereas Q on acidification gives a positive Tollens' test. Treatment of P with excess cyclohexanone in the presence of a catalytic amount of p-toluenesulfonic acid gives product R. What is the sum of the number of methylene groups (-CH2-) and oxygen atoms in R?
The carboxyl functional group (-COOH) is present in (A) picric acid (B) barbituric acid (C) ascorbic acid (D) aspirin

Statement I: The esterification of a carboxylic acid with an alcohol is a nucleophilic acyl substitution. Statement II: Electron withdrawing groups in the carboxylic acid increase the rate of the esterification reaction. Choose the correct answer: (A) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct (B) Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect (C) Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect (D) Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
